protocol.gate: exact200decode; all full raw vectors finite/nonzero before hashing; two fresh baseline replay processes after warmup must match bitwise; failed baseline classified ERRORE_BASELINE and long ranking disabled, short can continue

timing_preregister.samples: 4fresh processes per repeatable baseline case;3measured reps after warmup
timing_preregister.aggregate: median each metric over3reps in process, mean of4process medians
timing_preregister.order: short then long; failed baseline gate case excluded

timing_preregister.scope: baseline timing only; no direct speedup short/long or between engines
